'src/store.js':[("    this.tickets = new Map(initial.tickets.map((ticket) => [ticket.id, { ...ticket }]));\n    for (const ticket of this.tickets.values()) {\n      if (ticket.due === undefined) ticket.due = this.dueAt(ticket.created, ticket.priority);\n    }", "    this.tickets = new Map(initial.tickets.map((ticket) => [ticket.id, { assignee: null, ...ticket }]));\n    for (const ticket of this.tickets.values()) {\n      if (ticket.due === undefined) ticket.due = this.dueAt(ticket.created, ticket.priority);\n    }"),
("    const ticket = { id: formatId(this.nextNumber), title, priority, requester, status: 'open', created: at, updated: at };\n    ticket.due = this.dueAt(at, priority);", "    const ticket = { id: formatId(this.nextNumber), title, priority, requester, status: 'open', assignee: null, created: at, updated: at };\n    ticket.due = this.dueAt(at, priority);")],
'src/format.js':[("  const fields = ['status', 'priority', 'requester', 'created', 'updated', ...(ticket.due ? ['due'] : [])];", "  const fields = ['status', 'priority', 'requester', 'assignee', 'created', 'updated', ...(ticket.due ? ['due'] : [])];")],

}
for name, reps in replacements.items():
 p=root/name;s=p.read_text()
 s=re.sub(r'<<<<<<< HEAD\n(.*?)=======\n(.*?)>>>>>>> [^\n]+\n',lambda m:m[1],s,flags=re.S)
 for a,b in reps:
  assert a in s
  s=s.replace(a,b)
 p.write_text(s)
p=root/'src/tickets/query.js';s=p.read_text();s=re.sub(r'<<<<<<< HEAD\n(.*?)=======\n(.*?)>>>>>>> [^\n]+\n',lambda m:m[1]+'  }\n'+m[2],s,flags=re.S);p.write_text(s)
